bio.text: T.J. Shope is a Republican member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 16 and has served as Senate president pro tempore since 2023.
He represented District 8 in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2013 to 2021.
He was born in Florence, Arizona, lives in Coolidge, graduated from Coolidge High School in 2003, and earned a B.S. in political science from Arizona State University in 2008.
His career experience includes co-owning Shope's IGA Supermarket.
He advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
